concepts.def: Impact across raw material, use, disposal

walkthroughs.body_html:
An LCA looks at: raw material, manufacture, use and disposal.

Recycling reduces energy use, ore depletion and waste.

Phytomining: low energy, slow.

Bioleaching: lower energy, produces leachate solutions.

Traditional smelting: high yield, high CO2 emissions.

Haber: 200 atm, ~450 C, iron catalyst.

Contact process: V2O5 catalyst.

Conditions are compromises of rate, yield and cost.

mcqs.q: Which is a benefit of recycling metals?

options: Metal atoms themselves move to carry the current.
Metals contain naturally moving protons that act as charge carriers.
Delocalised electrons are free to move through the lattice of positive ions, carrying charge.
Higher temperature increases the concentration of the reactants.

mcqs.q: How does a catalyst speed up a reaction?
options: Higher temperature increases the concentration of the reactants.
It provides an alternative reaction pathway with a lower activation energy.
A catalyst lowers the activation energy of the original reaction pathway.
A catalyst gives extra kinetic energy to the reactant particles.

mcqs.q: Why does increasing temperature increase the rate of reaction significantly?
options: Higher temperature increases the concentration of the reactants.
Particles collide much more frequently at higher temperature, which is the main reason for the rate increase.
A catalyst gives extra kinetic energy to the reactant particles.
Mainly because a much larger fraction of collisions have energy at least equal to the activation energy; collision frequency increases only slightly.
